name: io.github.xHisusx/taiga-mcp-server
description: Read and manage your own Taiga projects: items, statuses, assignees, sprints, comments

environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Taiga instance root, without /api/v1. Taiga Cloud: https://api.taiga.io

environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Taiga username or email, used together with TAIGA_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_APP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Long-lived Application token, instead of a username and password

environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Default project (id, slug or name) for tool calls that omit one

environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the read tools only

environmentVariables.name: TAIGA_MCP_ALLOW_DELETE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to also register taiga_delete_item
